name: restart multi
description:
Restart flagged services in LXC containers on SEVERAL Proxmox hosts in one run.

You normally get here from the **list** report: tick containers there (across hosts) and click **go to restart** — this form is then prefilled with a Targets line like `host1:names...;host2:names...` (host: comma-separated containers). You can review or hand-edit it.

- **Dry run** (default) shows exactly what would be restarted and does nothing.
- **Restart** runs `needrestart-lxc -r` per host: every flagged service is restarted (`systemctl restart`, with escalation to kill + start and SIGKILL when KillMode leaves children behind). Non-systemd processes and scope units are never touched automatically.

Each host is scanned fresh and processed sequentially; the run fails if any host failed.

parameters.name: Targets
parameters.description: host: comma-separated containers, one entry per host, separated by ';'. Usually prefilled from the list report.

parameters.name: Exclude
parameters.description: Optional: regex of services to exclude on every host (can use alternation, e.g. `^dbus|^rsyslog`).

parameters.name: Action
parameters.description: Dry run only shows what would happen.

values_ui_mapping.dry-run: Dry run (show what would be restarted)
